citations.desc: Cleaning, sanitization, housekeeping, and pest control.
citations.narrative:
An APHIS official observed an excessive accumulation of food particles beneath hoppers attached to experimental
chambers used for rhesus macaques in Room 221, which is an investigator-maintained space. Additionally, there was an
excessive accumulation of food particles behind the chutes of the feeders in these chambers, which are inaccessible to
the animals and do not directly contact the food that the animals consume. In the same room, there was an buildup of
dust and debris on the fans inside the experimental chambers. Food particles and dust can harbor microorganisms and
and/or attract pests. The facility must ensure that premises are kept clean in order to protect nonhuman primates from
injury, facilitate husbandry practices, and reduce or eliminate breeding and living areas for pests. To be corrected by
August 6, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
